description: Quote a listing run: price per valid result, markup, and the maximum cost for max_results. The maximum is a hard cap; only valid results are billed and the rest is refunded. Free and keyless; this never reserves or debits anything. The quote carries health_state (healthy, degraded, unverified or failing) with success_rate_7d, sample_size and last_success_at; for a degraded or failing listing next_action says listing_degraded and alterlab_store_run needs accept_degraded=true. To run, call alterlab_store_run.
name: alterlab_store_quote
title: Quote Data Store Run
